chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Wassha from Abu al-Hasan al-Kazzaz said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying to Abu al-Abbas al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik, 'What prevented you from performing Hajj?' He said, 'A guarantee ( Kafalah ) that I undertook.' He said, 'What do you have to do with guarantees? Do you not know that the guarantee is that which destroyed the earlier generations?'
ai.seo_question: Why did the Imam say guarantees destroyed the earlier generations?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies financial guarantees (*Kafalah*) as a primary cause of the ruin of previous nations, linking economic entanglement to spiritual neglect. This highlights the Shia scholarly view that excessive worldly obligations can distract believers from essential acts of worship like Hajj, serving as a cautionary principle for financial prudence and prioritization of religious duties.
